name: Business revenue inconsistent with staffing or operating costs
description: Reported revenue, payroll or resident staff do not match the typical costs and workforce of the stated business model.
fp: Outsourcing, seasonal staffing and informal-sector norms can explain gaps; benchmark against peers.

links.name: Business front for exploitation with revenue not matching staff
links.ctx: Massage, nail, car-wash, restaurant or agricultural entity with cash patterns and many resident staff but poor payroll evidence.

links.name: Payroll volume inconsistent with declared headcount
links.ctx: Wages paid or invoiced greatly exceed declared staff and reported payroll tax. Labour provider shows no pension, insurance, equipment or accommodation costs.
